releases.name: v1.3.0
releases.notes: Two versions of work are rolled up here (v1.2.0 and v1.3.0). ## Better agent discovery and chain safety - New `scripts/discover-agents.mjs`: a read-only, zero-dependency CLI that lists your custom agents (slim and native sources) and flags risky fallback chains — duplicate model ids, chains outside 2–4 entries, non-Go fallback ids not confirmed in the local registry, and vision lanes whose model is not marked vision-verified. It prints compact JSON instead of making you read config files by hand. - New `scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs`: a compact digest of the cached model snapshot (~97% shorter than the raw file), with `--ids`, `--trait`, and `--json`. ## Clearer recommendations - The recommendation table now includes a **role overview** column: a one-line, plain-language description of wha…

en.headline: 21 commits across 3 repos; opencode-go-model-picker v1.3.0 released
en.summary: On 2026-10-04, sogetisetsu made 21 commits across three repositories with no pull requests, issues, or reviews. In meld-deepresearch (11 commits), work centered on evaluation documentation — adding live Q2 comparison results across three skills and a deep research evaluation standard — along with landing-page feedback fixes and cleanup of local worktree ignore blocks. In sogetisetsu (7 commits), the daily report generator was improved: automated-commit lines now show who initiated them and note they do not count toward totals, pure-bot repos are retained showing only counts, status-change badges preserve actor casing, a --rerender flag was added, status changes were split into their own section, and a GitHub homepage button was added with the 30-day card refreshing every 2 hours. In opencode-go-model-picker (3 commits), agent-discovery and snapshot-summary scripts were added, along with documentation for vision verification and a role-overview column. The repo also published release v1.3.0, rolling up v1.2.0 and v1.3.0 work including the new discover-agents.mjs CLI for listing custom agents and flagging risky fallback chains, and snapshot-summary.mjs for compact model snapshot digests.

releaseNotes.summary: Rolls up v1.2.0 and v1.3.0. Adds discover-agents.mjs, a read-only CLI that lists custom agents and flags risky fallback chains (duplicate model IDs, chains outside 2–4 entries, unconfirmed non-Go fallback IDs, unverified vision lanes). Also adds snapshot-summary.mjs for a compact model snapshot digest (~97% shorter than raw), and a role-overview column to the recommendation table.

zh.headline: 3 个仓库共 21 次提交；opencode-go-model-picker 发布 v1.3.0
zh.summary: 2026-10-04，sogeisetsu 在三个仓库共提交 21 次，无 PR、issue 或 review。meld-deepresearch（11 次提交）主要围绕评估文档——添加三项技能的 Q2 实时对比结果和深度研究评估标准——以及落地页反馈修复和本地 worktree 忽略块清理。sogeisetsu（7 次提交）改进了日报生成器：自动提交行补充了发起人并标注不计入总数，纯机器人提交的仓库仅显示次数，状态变更徽章保留 actor 原始大小写，新增 --rerender 参数，状态变更独立分节，并添加了 GitHub 主页按钮、30 天卡片改为每 2 小时刷新。opencode-go-model-picker（3 次提交）新增了 agent-discovery 和 snapshot-summary 脚本，并补充了视觉验证和角色概览列的文档。该仓库还发布了 v1.3.0，合并了 v1.2.0 和 v1.3.0 的工作，包括新增的 discover-agents.mjs CLI（列出自定义 agent 并标记风险回退链）和 snapshot-summary.mjs（紧凑模型快照摘要）。

releaseNotes.summary: 合并了 v1.2.0 和 v1.3.0 的工作。新增 discover-agents.mjs，一个只读 CLI，可列出自定义 agent 并标记风险回退链（重复模型 ID、链长不在 2–4 条、未确认的非 Go 回退 ID、未验证的视觉通道）。同时新增 snapshot-summary.mjs 用于紧凑模型快照摘要（比原始文件小约 97%），并在推荐表中添加了角色概览列。
